## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run verify` passes on my machine.
- [ ] A test covers the change (bug fixes and new features).
- [ ] The README matches the change (public API or behavior changes).
- [ ] CHANGELOG.md has a line under `## [Unreleased]` (changes users can see).
- [ ] The title is a Conventional Commit, such as `fix(scope): short description`.
